entities.name: Aryl Suzuki coupling with CsF
observations: Reaction contains 6-iodoquinoline, tricyclohexylphosphine, DMF, and cesium fluoride, consistent with palladium-catalyzed Suzuki coupling.
Search found no direct ORD precedent distinguishing the aryl pinacol boronate ester from the corresponding potassium aryltrifluoroborate under these exact conditions.

entities.name: Aryl pinacol boronate ester
observations: Candidate structure is an aryl Bpin reagent: Cc1ccc2c(cnn2C2CCCCO2)c1B1OC(C)(C)C(C)(C)O1.
Aryl pinacol boronates are standard Suzuki coupling partners and are directly compatible with palladium/base coupling conditions.

entities.name: Aryl potassium trifluoroborate
observations: Candidate structure is the corresponding potassium aryltrifluoroborate: Cc1ccc2c(cnn2C2CCCCO2)c1[B-](F)(F)F.[K+].
Potassium organotrifluoroborates generally require hydrolysis/activation and can be less directly reactive than aryl Bpin under unspecified Suzuki conditions.
